list.name: Changes
list.comment:
models.py — Wrote the two dataclasses from the PDF verbatim, with one addition: tags: str | None on OsuSong (Issue 5 fix). Everything else is as specified.
config.py — Loads .env via python-dotenv and exposes all the env vars from Section 9 as typed module-level constants. Nothing fancy — just a single place to import config from instead of sprinkling os.getenv calls across the codebase.
local_osu.py — Three functions: - _parse_osu_file — reads a .osu file, walks line by line, only collects keys from [General] and [Metadata] sections - _build_song — turns the raw key/value dict into an OsuSong. Prefers Unicode fields over ASCII, handles -1 beatmap IDs (osu! uses -1 for "no ID"), builds the osu! URLs - scan_local — recursively globs for *.osu, deduplicates by BeatmapSetID first, falls back to casefold artist|title key, returns one entry per beatmapset
export.py — Four functions for writing the four output files the spec defines: export_songs_csv, export_songs_json, export_matches_csv, export_unmatched_csv. Uses dataclasses.asdict to serialize OsuSong cleanly.
cli.py — Four commands registered with Typer matching the spec exactly (scan-local, fetch-osu, match-spotify, create-playlist). Only scan-local is wired up. The other three print "not implemented yet" and exit with code 1 — they're stubs so the CLI is already discoverable via --help.
normalize.py — Just the agreed-upon pattern list for now (no logic yet). The broad r"\[.*?\]" is absent. This file gets its actual implementation in MVP 3 when Spotify matching is built.
